== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Hollow Spear, also known as the Spear of the [[Hollow King]], is a [[Striker technique]] associated with the [[Path of the Hollow King]]. This path focuses on the property of emptiness, utilizing [[pure madra]] to dilute and replace other elements. The technique manifests as a lance or spear composed of blue-[[white madra]], though it can also take on more detailed physical forms. When projected from a [[sacred instrument]], such as silver scissors, it can combine the powers of both the weapon and the technique. The spear serves various tactical roles depending on its application. It is highly effective at disrupting or breaking the techniques of opponents, though it may be less efficient at directly defeating enemies at certain power levels. It can also function as a powerful conductor for [[soulfire]] and [[madra]], capable of delivering devastating spiritual damage or destroying a target's soul. In some instances, the technique has demonstrated immense destructive force, capable of carving long trenches into the landscape or striking high-level entities like a [[Sage]] or a [[Dreadgod]].}}
